description.value: Coral Court is a long-standing Szechuan-style Chinese restaurant in North Vancouver, serving an extensive menu of classic dishes including Dry Ginger Beef, Wonton Soup, and a wide range of beef, chicken, and seafood stir-fries. The restaurant offers both dine-in and online pickup ordering, with a dedicated lunch special menu. With 238 customer reviews and an active web presence, it is a well-established neighbourhood spot within easy reach of North Vancouver's cycling routes.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website at coral-court.com is live and active, confirming the restaurant is open with an online ordering system for pickup and delivery. Address (137 2nd St E), phone (604-987-3303), and website all match OSM tags. The menu page includes a 'Legend: spicy vegetarian' notation and lists tofu and vegetable dishes, confirming vegetarian options; takeout/pickup is explicitly offered via the online ordering system. No evidence for bike parking, washrooms, water refill, Wi-Fi, or other cycling-specific amenities appears anywhere on the website.
concerns: OSM name is 'Coral Court Szechuan Cuisine' but website branding is 'Coral Court | Chinese Cuisine' — minor naming discrepancy. Website postal code V7L1C2 not present in OSM address tags.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active restaurant with a functioning website and online ordering system; a straightforward include for the directory.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Menu legend explicitly marks vegetarian items; menu includes tofu dishes and a vegetable category
